name: Silk Road 2.0
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the Blockchain Graveyard label and description.
rootCause: If you trust the operators, they blame the famous "transaction malleability" vulnerability. Our initial investigations indicate that a vendor exploited a recently discovered vulnerability in the Bitcoin protocol known as “transaction malleability” to repeatedly withdraw coins from our system until it was completely empty.
